C: Length of the clock Earth's history is squeezed onto
L: Luminosity of a star, in units of the Sun's
M: Star's mass, in units of the Sun's
N: Number of civilizations transmitting now in the Galaxy
R_ast: New stars born each year in the Milky Way
f_c: Share of those that send out signals we could detect
f_i: Share of those where intelligence appears
f_l: Share of those planets where life starts
n_e: Habitable planets for each star with planets
t: Time ago (Earth's history), or a star's lifetime
